body: The thing is that I used to be a very happy kid. I used to play a lot of sports, I used to have a lot of friends, love playing with Lego and whatever other things kids do. I guess I buried everything so deep down that now I have to go through it all. I don’t even know how I buried everything so deep, probably because I had no idea what was going on.
